messages.subject: how to output hidden sheets
parts:
Hi,

Does anyone know how to export a sheet that is to be hidden by default?

I can import a workbook with two sheets - one visible, one hidden - no problem but I when I add new data frames to the hidden sheet and export it, it is no longer hidden.

The documentation says that "the user has control to set colors, fonts, data formats, add borders, hide/unhide sheets, add/remove rows, add/remove sheets, etc." but I can't find any example of this.

Any help would be greatly appreciated - thanks!

Best,

Sam

messages.author: 39408223a5f9f8a8
messages.subject: Re: how to output hidden sheets
parts:
I think this should work:

wb$setSheetHidden(wb$getSheetIndex("NAME_OF_YOUR_SHEET"), , wb$SHEET_STATE_HIDDEN)

where you replace NAME_OF_YOUR_SHEET with your sheet's name, e.g. Sheet2.
